segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאוֹמֵר לְבָנָיו: הֲרֵינִי שׁוֹחֵט אֶת הַפֶּסַח עַל מִי שֶׁיַּעֲלֶה מִכֶּם רִאשׁוֹן לִירוּשָׁלַיִם, כֵּיוָן שֶׁהִכְנִיס הָרִאשׁוֹן רֹאשׁוֹ וְרוּבּוֹ — זָכָה בְּחֶלְקוֹ וּמְזַכֶּה אֶת אֶחָיו עִמּוֹ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who says to his children: I am slaughtering the Paschal lamb on behalf of whomever of you goes up first to Jerusalem, as soon as the first» of the children «has entered his head and the majority of his» body into Jerusalem, «he has acquired his portion and acquires» on behalf of «his brothers» their portions together «with him.»

moves.summary: The first son to enter Jerusalem acquires his share and his brothers' with him

positions.claim: once the first son enters with head and majority, he acquires his share and acquires for his brothers with him
